name: Ooba Remi
source:
She is the wife of the main character Shizuya. She and her mother are estranged and do not get along well. 

However, she  gets help from her mother as she is burdened with raising a child for the first time.

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_199.html]official site[/url]]
